name: TREADWAY, DWAYNE R
pcp: M. Ledford, MD, Morristown Family Practice

case.procedure: Open umbilical hernia repair, primary vs mesh
case.indication: Symptomatic incarcerating umbilical hernia in setting of cirrhotic ascites. 2.1 cm fascial defect containing omentum, painful, only partially reducible in clinic 10/16. No bowel obstruction on US. Thinning overlying skin; risk of rupture/leak.
case.blood: Type and crossmatch 2 units PRBC; FFP/platelets per anesthesia
case.surgeon_notes: Child B per hepatology 8/2026. LVP by IR 10/20 (5 L) to decompress before repair. Will avoid mesh if contamination or skin compromise. Hepatology aware and agrees surgery reasonable given rupture risk. Will need post-op albumin per hepatology.

problems: Esophageal varices s/p hemorrhage, EVL eradication
Alcohol use disorder, severe, in reported remission

pmh: Alcohol-associated cirrhosis dx 08/2021 (first presentation: new ascites); HCV Ab neg, HBsAg neg, HBV immune (vaccinated)
Esophageal variceal hemorrhage 03/2025 - EVL, transfused, intubated for EGD; eradicated by serial EVL 07/2025
Hepatic encephalopathy grade 2, 11/2023 (constipation/UTI precipitated) - lactulose + rifaximin since
Chronic low back pain, no daily opioids
family: No known anesthesia problems in family

social.alcohol: Reports none since 06/2024 (previously 12-18 beers/day x 25 yrs)
social.occupation: Former long-haul truck driver; SSDI since 2022
social.living: Lives alone in a single-wide, Bean Station. Sister checks on him; she drives him to appointments.
social.other: Completed 6-wk IOP 2021 (relapsed). No current AA attendance per 8/2026 note.

1 tab PO q8h PRN pain (max 2 g/day per hepatology)

imaging: Peripancreatic fat stranding and fluid consistent with acute interstitial edematous pancreatitis. No necrosis. Hepatic steatosis. Small umbilical fat-containing hernia. Impression: Acute pancreatitis without necrosis.

Liver coarsened, nodular contour. Moderate ascites. Spleen 14.8 cm. Portal vein patent, hepatopetal flow, velocity 18 cm/s. Gallbladder wall thickening attributed to ascites. Impression: Cirrhotic morphology with splenomegaly and ascites.
Lungs clear. No effusion. Heart size normal. Impression: No acute disease.
No hemorrhage, mass, or infarct. Mild generalized volume loss, advanced for age. Impression: No acute intracranial abnormality.
ETT tip 4 cm above carina. OG tube in stomach. Lungs clear. Impression: Lines/tubes as above.
MRI Abdomen liver protocol with contrast

Cirrhotic liver. 9 mm segment VI arterially enhancing focus without washout or capsule, LI-RADS 3. Moderate ascites. Splenomegaly 16.1 cm. Recanalized paraumbilical vein. Small umbilical hernia containing fluid and fat. Impression: LI-RADS 3 observation; repeat imaging 3-6 months.
Nodular liver. No discrete mass. Segment VI observation not seen by US. Moderate ascites. Impression: No US evidence of HCC; MRI recommended per LI-RADS follow-up.
Left parietal scalp hematoma. No intracranial hemorrhage. No calvarial fracture. Impression: No acute intracranial abnormality.
No fracture or malalignment. Multilevel spondylosis C5-C7. Impression: No acute fracture.

2.1 cm fascial defect at umbilicus containing omentum and ascitic fluid; overlying skin thinned to 2 mm. Bowel not seen within sac. Peristalsis normal in adjacent loops. Impression: Umbilical hernia with omental content; partially reducible with probe pressure.
Large-volume paracentesis left lower quadrant, 5.0 L clear straw-colored fluid removed. Albumin 25% 40 g given per protocol. No complications. Post-procedure moderate residual ascites.

Small right pleural effusion, new from 2021. Lungs otherwise clear. Heart size normal. Elevation of right hemidiaphragm. Impression: Small right pleural effusion, possibly hepatic hydrothorax in this patient with cirrhosis.
cardiology: Sinus tachycardia 108. Normal axis. QTc 452. No ST changes.
Sinus tachycardia 122. Low voltage limb leads. QTc 488. No acute ST changes.

LVEF 65-70%, hyperdynamic. Normal LV size. Grade I diastolic dysfunction. RV normal size and function, TAPSE 2.4 cm. RVSP 28 mm Hg. Agitated saline: no early or late bubbles (no intracardiac or intrapulmonary shunt). Trivial pericardial effusion. Impression: Normal biventricular function; no evidence of portopulmonary hypertension or hepatopulmonary shunt.
pH 7.44, PaCO2 33, PaO2 86, A-a gradient 20 mm Hg. Impression: Mild respiratory alkalosis; no hypoxemia.
Sinus bradycardia 58. Normal axis. PR 172. QTc 481. Nonspecific T-wave flattening. Compared with 03/2025: rate slower, QTc similar.

Discharged home; CIWA required lorazepam day 2

notes: Annual exam. 47M truck driver. Drinks "a case on my days off, 6-8 on work nights." AUDIT-C 11. LFTs: AST 98, ALT 51 (AST:ALT ~2), MCV 103, TG 288. Exam: no stigmata of chronic liver disease, no hepatomegaly appreciated. A/P: Alcohol use disorder, likely alcoholic fatty liver. Counseled at length; declined naltrexone and declined referral. Hep A/B vaccines offered - declined today. Recheck LFTs 6 mo. Flu shot given.

Admit 05/14 - D/C 05/17. Dx: acute alcoholic pancreatitis (lipase 1,840, CT without necrosis). Last drink morning of admission. Required CIWA protocol, lorazepam 2 mg x3 doses on HD2 for tremor/tachycardia/diaphoresis (max CIWA 17); no seizures, no DTs. NPO then advanced to low-fat diet. Discharged on thiamine, folate. Strongly advised abstinence. F/u PCP 2 wk.

Low back pain after long haul, no red flags. BP 138/86. States cut down to "weekends only." Tramadol 50 mg PRN #30. Colonoscopy discussed - declined. Platelets 132, trending down from 168 in 2016 - will monitor.

Admit 08/03 - D/C 08/08. Presented with 3 wk abdominal distension, 18 lb weight gain. Dx: decompensated alcohol-associated cirrhosis with new ascites. Diagnostic/therapeutic paracentesis 4.2 L: SAAG 2.2, PMN 60 (no SBP). Viral hepatitis neg. MELD 15 on admission. Ethanol not detected on arrival; pt reported last drink 2 days PTA; CIWA max 9, no benzodiazepines needed. Started spironolactone 100 / furosemide 40, 2 g Na diet. Hep A/B vaccine series started. GI referral for variceal screening (pt did not schedule). IOP referral placed. Stopped tramadol and NSAIDs.

Met with pt re alcohol use. Pt tearful, states "this scared me." Agreeable to Cornerstone IOP (6 wk). Lives alone; sister Rhonda involved. Discussed driving/CDL - pt aware he will not return to commercial driving. Disability application information provided.

Cirrhosis f/u. Completed IOP 11/2021, reports abstinent since 08/2021. Ascites controlled on diuretics. No HE. EGD screening still not done - rescheduled (pt cancelled x2 for transport). CTP A (6) today: bili 1.4, alb 3.3, INR 1.3, minimal ascites on diuretics, no HE. MELD 11. HCC surveillance US q6mo ordered.

Itchy rough spots on back. Exam: 4 stuck-on brown papules on back consistent with seborrheic keratoses. Several spider angiomata upper chest noted. Reassurance; cryotherapy x2 irritated lesions. No f/u needed.

Admit 11/18 - D/C 11/22. Brought by sister for confusion, somnolence x2 days. West Haven grade 2 HE, ammonia 118 (not used for management). Precipitants: constipation (no BM x4 days, not taking lactulose regularly) and E. coli cystitis. Diagnostic paracentesis neg for SBP. Treated with lactulose titration and ceftriaxone, transitioned to cefpodoxime. Added rifaximin 550 BID for secondary prophylaxis. Back to baseline HD3. Pt denies alcohol use. Discharged home with sister.

F/u. Pt states he "quit for good this month" after brother was hospitalized. Admits relapse 2022-2024, "a 12-pack most days." Encouraged; AA info given. Labs: plt 94, INR 1.4. Continues lactulose/rifaximin. Smoking 1/2 ppd, not ready to quit. Nicotine patch Rx (pt unlikely to use).

Admit 03/08 - D/C 03/14. Presented with hematemesis x3, Hgb 6.9, HR 120s, BP 88/50. Intubated in MICU for airway protection prior to EGD (RSI etomidate/succinylcholine, MAC 4, grade 1 view, 7.5 ETT, uneventful). EGD: large esophageal varices with stigmata of recent bleeding (white nipple sign); 5 bands placed. Octreotide x72 h, ceftriaxone 1 g daily x5 d then cipro to complete 7 d, 2 u PRBC (target Hgb 7-8). Extubated HD2. CIWA scoring: max 6, no withdrawal; pt reports no alcohol since 06/2024. Started nadolol (later changed to propranolol) plus serial EVL for secondary prophylaxis. Pantoprazole x course post-banding.

EGD with EVL #4 under MAC (propofol, nasal cannula). Small residual grade 1 varices distal esophagus, 2 bands placed. No gastric varices. Mild portal hypertensive gastropathy. Varices considered eradicated. Repeat EGD 6-12 months. Continue propranolol 20 BID (HR goal 55-65).

Transplant discussion. CTP B (8): bili 1.9 (2), alb 3.1 (2), INR 1.4 (1), mild-moderate ascites on diuretics (2), HE controlled on rx (1 - none on exam, on prophylaxis). MELD 14. MRI: LI-RADS 3 segment VI. TTE/ABG screening done - no POPH/HPS. Explained that transplant referral requires documented sustained abstinence, engagement in AUD treatment, and random PEth testing. Pt states abstinent since 06/2024. Sister present, supportive. Plan: PEth at next visits, f/u 6 mo.
Pt called for lactulose and rifaximin refills. Rifaximin prior auth renewed (BlueCare). Reminded of MRI due 3/2026; pt states he cannot afford gas this month. Sister will call to schedule.

Referral for cirrhosis nutrition. Wt 81 kg (with ascites), est dry wt ~75 kg. Grip strength reduced, temporal wasting mild - moderate malnutrition (sarcopenia likely). Goals: protein 1.2-1.5 g/kg dry wt, 35 kcal/kg, 2 g Na, do not restrict protein, late-evening snack, avoid fasting >6 h. Pt eats one meal a day plus snacks. Provided handouts.

Cirrhosis f/u. Wt up 4 kg, increased abdominal girth, umbilical bulge. Pt reports adherence to diuretics and lactulose (2-3 BMs/day). States no alcohol since 06/2024. Exam: tense-ish ascites, small soft reducible umbilical hernia, no asterixis, scleral icterus. Labs: Na 130, Cr 0.9, bili 2.1, alb 2.9, INR 1.5, plt 76. CTP B (9): bili 2, alb 2, INR 1, ascites 2, HE 2 (on meds). MELD 14. Plan: increase spironolactone 200/furosemide 80. PEth today per transplant pathway. MRI ordered (LI-RADS 3 follow-up, still not done). Umbilical hernia: discussed risk of incarceration/rupture; will refer to surgery if symptomatic. RTC 6 wk.
PEth 286 ng/mL. Will address in person at next visit; transplant referral on hold. Routed to Dr. Sandoval.

Fall down 3 porch steps tonight, struck head, no LOC per pt. Brought by EMS (neighbor called). Smells of alcohol, slurred speech, ambulatory with assist. GCS 14 (E4V4M6). 4 cm L parietal scalp lac. Serum ethanol 180 mg/dL. Pt states he "had two beers at a cookout." Glucose 88. CT head/C-spine neg. INR 1.6, plt 70. Lac repaired with 5 staples. Tdap given. CIWA 4 at 0300. Observed until clinically sober; ambulating steadily, discharged to sister 0540. Staple removal 7-10 d PCP. Advised alcohol cessation; resources given.
Pt resting on stretcher, sister at bedside. Sister states pt "has been drinking again since summer, he hides it." Pt became upset and asked her to leave. Scalp lac dressing dry/intact.

Lab f/u: Na 126, Cr 1.41 (from 0.9). Likely diuretic-induced AKI/hyponatremia. Reduced spironolactone to 100 and furosemide to 40. Fluid restriction 1.5 L. Recheck BMP 2 wk. Pt did not bring up ED visit; PEth result not discussed (pt left before provider returned - transport). Rescheduled.

Referred by hepatology for painful umbilical hernia. Pain 6/10 x10 days, worse with cough, only partially reducible in clinic, skin over hernia thin and shiny without ulceration or leak. No N/V, normal BMs (on lactulose). US: 2.1 cm defect with omentum. PMH cirrhosis, Child B per hepatology 8/2026, MELD ~14-16. Social: former drinker, quit 2024. A/P: Symptomatic incarcerating umbilical hernia with ascites. Risk of strangulation and spontaneous rupture (Flood syndrome) outweighs elective deferral. Plan: LVP by IR next week to control ascites, then open repair 10/27. Discussed higher risk of recurrence, ascitic leak, wound complications, decompensation, and mortality in cirrhosis. Pt agrees.
US-guided LVP LLQ, 5.0 L removed. Albumin 25% 40 g IV. Fluid sent. Pre-procedure INR 1.7, plt 69 - no transfusion per society guidance for paracentesis. No bleeding. Tolerated well.

PAT visit. 57M cirrhosis for open umbilical hernia repair. ETOH: former heavy use, quit 06/2024 per pt. Smoker. METs ~4 (walks mailbox and back, limited by abdominal distension). Airway: MP II, TMD 6 cm, full dentition with several broken molars, neck ROM full. Prior anesthetics: MICU intubation 2025 grade 1 per DS; MAC EGDs uneventful. Labs: Na 128, plt 68, INR 1.7, fibrinogen 142, alb 2.6. ECG QTc 481. CXR small R effusion. Plan GA with RSI (ascites, full stomach precautions). T&C 2 u. Consider viscoelastic testing. Day-of-surgery BMP/CBC. Continue propranolol, rifaximin, PPI AM of surgery; hold diuretics.

Med rec completed with pt and sister by phone. Note: pt receives lactulose 30 mL BID but takes "when I remember." Acetaminophen limited to 2 g/day. Thiamine listed as home med; no inpatient thiamine order present - recommend thiamine 100 mg IV before any dextrose. Rifaximin supply OK. Recommend avoiding benzodiazepines when possible given HE history.

Preop call. Arrive 0930. NPO solids after midnight, clears until 1130. Take propranolol, rifaximin, pantoprazole AM with sip of water. Hold spironolactone and furosemide AM. Take lactulose tonight. Sister driving and staying. Pt verbalized understanding.
Can I get a handicap parking sticker form filled out. Walking from the parking deck is hard with my belly. Thank you.
Disabled parking placard medical certification completed and mailed to patient.

H&P of 10/16 reviewed, pt examined, no interval change except mild increase in hernia tenderness. Abdomen: moderate ascites (reaccumulating), umbilical hernia tender, partially reducible. Child B cirrhosis, MELD 16. Quit alcohol 2024. Consent signed. Site N/A (midline). Proceed as planned.
orders: Point-of-care glucose on arrival and q2h while NPO
Admit to step-down post-op, hepatology consult

preop.nursing_note: 57M A&O x4, slow to answer some questions but appropriate. Mild jaundice. Abdomen distended, firm, umbilical hernia tender to touch, skin intact, no drainage. Small ecchymoses bilateral forearms. Healed scalp lac. Last BM this AM x2 (lactulose). Denies alcohol "since 2024." Smoked 1 cigarette this AM. Mild hand tremor noted, pt states "I always shake a little." Sister at bedside. 20 g R forearm on 2nd attempt, LR KVO.
